This is a real, functionally significant bug beyond the four defects both responses share. Response A's claim about ZeroDivisionError firing on `top_scores([])` is imprecise (IndexError actually fires first at the default limit), while B correctly notes this interaction, but B's added precision on an already-identified defect doesn't outweigh A's discovery of a wholly separate, valid defect.
